args.query: Express request logging with pino-http, request ids and redacted authorization header

results.title: Express 5 + pino-http structured request logging
results.summary: Structured JSON request logs in Express 5 with pino-http: request ids, redacted auth headers and per-request child loggers.

results.title: pino logging with redaction, request context and a custom transport
results.summary: A pino 10 logger with path and wildcard redaction, error serialisers, string levels and an AsyncLocalStorage mixin for request ids, plus a pino-abstract-transport alert sink combined via multistream, tested offline against in-memory streams.

results.title: http-errors with Express error middleware
results.summary: Express routes that throw http-errors and reject asynchronously, mapped by a central middleware to RFC 7807 problem details with expose-aware messages and a 500 fallback, tested offline with supertest.

results.title: express-validator request checks with supertest
results.summary: Validate Express JSON bodies and query params with express-validator, returning field errors, tested with supertest offline.

results.title: express-openapi-validator request and response validation
results.summary: Validate an Express app against an inline OpenAPI 3 spec using express-openapi-validator, returning validation errors as JSON and testing valid and invalid requests offline with supertest.

results.title: cors express preflight
results.summary: Configure cors with express to reflect allowed origins, answer OPTIONS preflight with Access-Control-Allow-* headers, and deny a disallowed origin, tested offline with supertest.

results.title: express 5 async error handling
results.summary: Use express 5 with supertest to forward rejected async handlers to a JSON error middleware, with router-level params, a JSON 404 handler and offline tests.

results.title: Joi request validation middleware for Express 5
results.summary: Validate Express 5 bodies and query strings with Joi schemas in a reusable middleware, with defaults, type conversion, stripUnknown and 400 error details, tested with supertest.

results.title: Twilio webhook signature validation in Express with TwiML replies
results.summary: Validate X-Twilio-Signature on inbound SMS webhooks in Express with twilio.validateRequest, including query strings and tampered params, and reply with MessagingResponse TwiML, tested offline with supertest.

results.title: passport-local express session auth
results.summary: Authenticate express requests with passport LocalStrategy against an in-memory store, persist the login with express-session and guard a protected route offline.
